Ana (docs): quick sync - drafting a compact 'lifeboat' section for bursty 429s and intermittent timeouts. plan: python + node snippets, a curl example, and a short triage checklist. any concerns?
Jordan (eng-runtime): call out Retry-After and a generic X-Rate-Hint header; mention model fallback (smaller or quantized) and latency vs quality tradeoffs.
Sasha (devex): keep snippets idiomatic and copy-paste ready; add a note about prefix caching for repeated prompts.
Kai (support): add common customer causes to checklist: websocket reconnect storms, client retry loops, cron bursts, per-key burst windows; link to support runbook 402.
docs-bot: add anchors #lifeboat and #sdk-snippets.
Ana (docs): pushed PR #1842 with short examples (python/node/curl). will honor Retry-After in snippets and include triage checklist. merging after final quick review.
Sasha (devex): minor wording tweak in PR, LGTM.
Jordan (eng-runtime): also suggest calling out when to enable caching vs fallback.
Ana (docs): added both points and merged. will follow up to add cross-links to the model catalog.
